mapper.select: SELECT pm.DOMAIN_ID , pm.COMPANY_CD , pm.PROJECT_ID , pm.PROJECT_NM , pm.PROJECT_DESC , pm.PROJECT_STATE_CD , SF_GET_CODE_NM('ko-KR', 'CM008', pm.PROJECT_STATE_CD, pm.COMPANY_CD, pm.DOMAIN_ID) AS PROJECT_STATE_NM , pm.PROJECT_CATEGORY_CD , pm.PROJECT_START_DT , pm.PROJECT_END_DT , pm.PROJECT_OWNER_MEMBER_ID , SF_GET_MEMBER_NAME(pm.PROJECT_OWNER_MEMBER_ID) AS PROJECT_OWNER_MEMBER_NM , pm.DEL_YN , pm.UPDATE_USR , CONVERT_TZ(pm.UPDATE_DT, '+00:00', '+09:00') AS UPDATE_DT , pm.CREATE_USR , CONVERT_TZ(pm.CREATE_DT, '+00:00', '+09:00') AS CREATE_DT FROM project_master pm WHERE pm.PROJECT_ID = #{projectId} AND pm.DEL_YN = #{delYn}

SELECT pm.DOMAIN_ID , pm.COMPANY_CD , pm.EMAIL , em.EMP_NM , pm.PROJECT_ID , pm.PROJECT_EMP_CD , pm.UPDATE_USR , CONVERT_TZ(pm.UPDATE_DT, '+00:00', '+09:00') AS UPDATE_DT , pm.CREATE_USR , CONVERT_TZ(pm.CREATE_DT, '+00:00', '+09:00') AS CREATE_DT FROM PROJECT_EMP pm INNER JOIN EMP_MASTER em ON (pm.EMAIL = em.EMAIL) WHERE pm.DOMAIN_ID = #{domainId} AND pm.PROJECT_ID = #{projectId} AND pm.PROJECT_EMP_CD = #{projectEmpCd}

SELECT pm.DOMAIN_ID , pm.COMPANY_CD , pm.EMAIL , em.EMP_NM , pm.PROJECT_ID , pm.PROJECT_EMP_CD , pm.UPDATE_USR , CONVERT_TZ(pm.UPDATE_DT, '+00:00', '+09:00') AS UPDATE_DT , pm.CREATE_USR , CONVERT_TZ(pm.CREATE_DT, '+00:00', '+09:00') AS CREATE_DT FROM PROJECT_EMP pm INNER JOIN EMP_MASTER em ON (pm.EMAIL = em.EMAIL) WHERE pm.DOMAIN_ID = #{domainId} AND pm.PROJECT_ID = #{projectId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_emp pm INNER JOIN company_master cm ON (pm.DOMAIN_ID = cm.DOMAIN_ID AND cm.COMPANY_CD = pm.COMPANY_CD) INNER JOIN emp_master em ON (pm.EMAIL = em.EMAIL) INNER JOIN DEPT_MASTER dm ON (em.DEPT_CD = dm.DEPT_CD AND em.DOMAIN_ID = dm.DOMAIN_ID AND em.COMPANY_CD = dm.COMPANY_CD) WHERE pm.PROJECT_ID = #{projectId} AND STR_TO_DATE(em.ENTER_DT, '%Y%m%d') <= CURDATE() AND ( em.QUIT_DT IS NULL OR em.QUIT_DT = '' OR STR_TO_DATE(em.QUIT_DT, '%Y%m%d') >= CURDATE() )
AND em.EMP_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{empNm}, '%')

SELECT pm.DOMAIN_ID , pm.COMPANY_CD , cm.COMPANY_NM , pm.EMAIL , em.EMP_NM , SF_GET_CODE_NM('ko-KR', '03000', em.POS_CD, em.COMPANY_CD, em.DOMAIN_ID) AS POS_NM , dm.DEPT_NM , pm.PROJECT_ID , pm.PROJECT_EMP_CD , SF_GET_CODE_NM('ko-KR', 'CM004', pm.PROJECT_EMP_CD, pm.COMPANY_CD, pm.DOMAIN_ID) AS PROJECT_EMP_NM , pm.UPDATE_USR , CONVERT_TZ(pm.UPDATE_DT, '+00:00', '+09:00') AS UPDATE_DT , pm.CREATE_USR , CONVERT_TZ(pm.CREATE_DT, '+00:00', '+09:00') AS CREATE_DT FROM project_emp pm INNER JOIN company_master cm ON (pm.DOMAIN_ID = cm.DOMAIN_ID AND cm.COMPANY_CD = pm.COMPANY_CD) INNER JOIN emp_master em ON (pm.EMAIL = em.EMAIL) INNER JOIN DEPT_MASTER dm ON (em.DEPT_CD = dm.DEPT_CD AND em.DOMAIN_ID = dm.DOMAIN_ID AND em.COMPANY_CD = dm.COMPANY_CD) WHERE pm.PROJECT_ID = #{projectId} AND STR_TO_DATE(em.ENTER_DT, '%Y%m%d') <= CURDATE() AND ( em.QUIT_DT IS NULL OR em.QUIT_DT = '' OR STR_TO_DATE(em.QUIT_DT, '%Y%m%d') >= CURDATE() )
AND em.EMP_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{empNm}, '%')
ORDER BY pm.PROJECT_EMP_CD DESC , em.EMP_NM
LIMIT #{start}, #{length}
